primary_gt.mechanism_question: diagnose whether pollutant or aerosol burden persists over a receptor window after accounting for meteorology and removal modifiers
primary_gt.decisive_evidence: Burden, duration, and receptor context carry the diagnosis; precipitation or surface products are modifiers or counterchecks.
primary_gt.rejected_simplifications: Reject ordinary-weather, rain-dominated, local-heat, or surface-change explanations if they fail to explain the receptor burden.
primary_gt.bounded_interpretation: Do not infer individual dose, clinical outcomes, emissions inventory, or source apportionment beyond the package.

decision_support.decision_rule: Pass only when heat_load_c_day >= 10.0, peak_heat_margin_c > 0.0, ventilation_ratio <= 1.0, and airborne_alignment_count == 3.

event.event_name: Mediterranean heatwave wildfire smoke and dust episode
event.hazard_label: Air pollution, smoke, and heat exposure

airborne_flags.text_scope: Heat and dust are extracted from the clean article body; wildfire-smoke alignment requires the article's Greece wildfire paragraph plus the locked event anchor's wildfire-smoke wording.

criteria.name: mechanism_diagnosis
criteria.description: Identifies the dominant physical process and gives the correct compact answer label or an equivalent diagnosis.

criteria.name: computed_evidence
criteria.description: Recomputes the quantitative evidence inherited from the original task and preserves units, signs, ratios, and key values.

criteria.name: evidence_weighting
criteria.description: Explains which evidence streams are decisive and which are contextual or weaker proxies.

criteria.name: counterfactual_rejection
criteria.description: Rejects at least one tempting simplified explanation using the computed values rather than assertion.

criteria.name: bounded_interpretation
criteria.description: States scale, timing, proxy, or uncertainty limits without adding unsupported losses or impacts.

criteria.name: json_contract
criteria.description: Returns the requested structured mechanism-diagnosis JSON without reducing the answer to a row-only table or same-scale checklist.

provenance.notes: Values are derived from local CSX-202 package data and deterministic formulas; airborne text flags avoid page metadata, navigation text, and related-content cards.
